top_signals.title: Petrobras Pumps at Record as Iran War Upends Oil Markets
top_signals.summary: Brazil’s state-controlled oil producer Petrobras lifted production to a record and ran its refineries near full capacity in the third quarter, helping the country weather disruptions to global energy markets from the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
top_signals.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Fed holds fire as Warsh telegraphs more hikes without saying it
top_signals.summary: Warsh used his assessment of a strong economy and warnings over persistent inflation to signal the Fed's job is not yet done.

top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Fall After Alphabet, Fed Holds: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stock-index futures retreated in early Asian trading after Alphabet Inc.’s earnings disappointed, reviving concerns about the billions of dollars companies are pouring into artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Housebuilding to fall for three years as red tape scuppers Labour’s new homes push
top_signals.summary: The UK’s progress towards its ambitious housebuilding target has been dealt another blow after the fiscal watchdog said housing output is set to slow for another three years.  The Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR) said housing delivery will fall to 229,000 this year, to 221,000 the following year and to 219,000 in the year 2027-28. top_signals.title: Crypto PAC spending before midterms possibly obscured after reported FEC hack
top_signals.summary: The FEC reported an “electronic filing system outage” on Tuesday as groups are expected to ramp up spending before the US midterm elections.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
top_signals.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year for the half of U.S. households heating with those fuels. Higher prices for electricity and heating oil drive increased expenditures for households heating with those fuels in our forecast.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Apple brings touch to the Mac, reversing years-old stance on touchscreen laptop
top_signals.summary: Apple announces a new touchscreen laptop, the company's third major launch under new CEO John Ternus.
